title: Print Footer Navbar Parity
description: The print LaTeX footer leaves too much space below it and should sit closer to the physical page bottom.
summary: Aligned print footer chrome with the navbar by rendering it through fancyhdr instead of eso-pic shipout at the physical page corner. Footer now uses \fancyfoot[C]{\SemioChromeFooterHead} with the same headwidth=textwidth centering and single-spacing inner padding as the navbar. Disabled the eso-pic footer shipout hook. Verified paper.pdf builds and rasterized page-2 artifacts in the ticket folder.
